• Objective for next meeting: 60–90 minute technical immersion (ML infra deep dive) to walk your platform team through runtime behavior, deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private), and a short Q&A on security/compliance (SSO, data residency, audit logs).

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Wed, May 27 — 10:00–11:30 PDT
- Thu, May 28 — 13:00–14:30 PDT

If neither works, please share two windows that suit Tom and Emily and we can pivot. For the session we typically include: Solutions Engineer (Aditya) to lead the demo/runbook, Product (me) for architecture and SLAs, and an infra engineer (Laura) for deployment questions.

Please also confirm the attendee list and whether you want us to cover SOC 2 artifact locations and our retention model in the session. I attached a draft agenda as a starting point (draft-tdx-agenda.pdf).

Next steps: can you confirm a preferred slot and attendee roster?

Thanks,
